title: COVID-19 RNA Extraction
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map: place the magnetic module in slot 4, the temperature module in slot 1, a NEST or USA Scientific 96‑deepwell plate on the magnetic module, and the two 12‑channel reservoirs in the positions shown in the Setup diagram.

steps.title: Arrange reagents in reservoirs
steps.instruction: Load the required reagents into the two 12‑channel reservoirs exactly as indicated in the Setup section of the protocol.

steps.title: Load lysed samples
steps.instruction: Dispense lysed COVID‑19 samples into the 96‑deepwell plate on the magnetic module (slot 4), using the same well mapping that will be used for the elution plate (e.g., sample well A1 maps to elution well A1, B1 to B1, etc.).

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set ‘park tips’ to yes (recommended) to conserve tips between reagent addition and removal; decide whether ‘track tips across protocol runs’ is yes or no; set ‘flash’ to yes if you want the robot rail lights to flash during automatic pauses, otherwise set to no.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the tiprack, pipette, and all labware on the deck; follow the support article for using calibration tips.
